nodes.name: Validate manifest and build tracking links

parameters.content:
# Campaign launch audit

## Who is this for?
Marketing teams checking campaign landing pages before a launch.

## How it works
The workflow validates a campaign manifest and limits requests to explicitly approved HTTPS hosts. It builds consistent UTM links, removes duplicate destinations before fetching, and sends rate-limited HTTP requests with redirects disabled. It then joins the results back to every campaign placement and reports HTTP failures, redirects, unexpected content types, missing titles, noindex hints, canonical tags, expected-copy checks and oversized responses. Each placement receives a priority and next action. It produces a spreadsheet-ready CSV plus an escaped HTML launch report. An optional SMTP branch sends a summary only when explicitly enabled.

## Setup
Edit Campaign audit settings: enter your own approvedHosts and placements, UTM values and expected text. Use only public websites you own or are authorized to check. Execute manually and download both reports. Inspect blockers before launch. HTTP statuses are observations, not proof of conversion performance.

## Requirements and limits
Built-in nodes only. No paid APIs. SMTP credentials are needed only for optional email; sending is off by default. Maximum 50 placements, 15-second request timeout, one request per second, no automatic retries. Redirects are reported for manual correction rather than followed. JavaScript-rendered content, login-only pages, DNS rebinding protection and browser-level analytics testing are outside this workflow. Use n8n's network protections when handling untrusted hosts. No private or IP-literal hosts are accepted. Changes are made only to reports, never websites.

## 1. Configure and fetch
Edit only the settings node. Exact approved hosts only; GET requests are limited to 50 placements, deduplicated per destination. No redirects or automatic retries. Use trusted public sites. Query values are transmitted to those sites. An invalid manifest stops before requests.

## 2. Inspect and prioritize
Transport errors and HTTP failures become blockers. Missing content/title, noindex and non-HTML responses become review items. Canonical and redirect values are evidence, never followed automatically. HTML inspection is heuristic, not browser rendering.

## 3. Download or email
CSV contains every placement, including duplicates sharing one fetch. HTML is escaped. Email is OFF by default. To enable it, configure SMTP credentials on Send launch audit summary and set sender, recipient and sendEmail=true. No credentials are included.
